text.p: Stone Media Corp said Thursday it planned to undertake organizational and financial restructuring over the next three months that includes the merging of one of its subsidiaries and the spin off of two of its business lines.
The company said it plans to fold its EPOCH Communications Corp subsidiary into the company and to assume the EPOCH name.
It said it also expects to spin off two of its business lines into two separate public companies traded over the counter.
The first company, which will be based in Middlebury, Conn., will be called Stone Interactive and will focus on the sale of EPOCH's proprietary interactive equipment.
The other company, which will be based in Temple, Texas, will be named StoneMedia Communications Corp. Its primary business will be the sale of bandwidth and providing Internet access.

The company said it hopes the restructuring will maximize shareholder value by creating independent companies without interlocking directors or officers. Shareholders of Stone Media will become shareholders of the spin-off companies.
